gen-flavors-gf-anaheim: Whimsical and a little bossy, Flavors towers up top with its stubby, pencil-thick strokes. And Anaheim follows in rounded sans-serif forms that huddle close, so the eye slides along beneath without catching.
gen-flavors-gf-arsenal: Arsenal keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with gaps so small they barely register. Arsenal also adds a faint swell inside each stroke, which gives Flavors, drawn at one thickness, something softer to stand against.
gen-flavors-gf-arsenal-sc: Flavors draws every line at the same hum of weight, with a towering lowercase that looks hand-stubbed from a carpenter's pencil. Arsenal SC reads tight and clean, its stems a touch heavier than its crossbars.
gen-flavors-gf-asimovian: Asimovian builds each tall lowercase letter from a single stroke width, friendly and unfussy. Under Flavors, with its towering whimsy, text moves along smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-basic: Chunky, playful, and surprisingly orderly. Flavors has bowls as thick as its stems, while Basic offers a gentle step from small letters to capitals, and that quiet restraint is the pair's best trick.
gen-flavors-gf-cal-sans: Flavors has diagonals as heavy as its stems and a lowercase that towers like a pencil stroke. Cal Sans keeps one stroke width throughout, and Flavors does its best work big and brief.
gen-flavors-gf-carlito: Whimsical, wiry, and tall: Flavors looks like tubing bent into letters. Carlito's tight, spool-wound spacing and small capitals sit beneath it, so the heading's drama gets a modern sans that stays quietly readable.
gen-flavors-gf-changa: Flavors brings whimsy with towering lowercase and no calligraphic modulation, all stubby pencil strokes with commanding presence. Changa's lowercase has cast-iron stature too, so the sans-serif body holds its own beneath.
gen-flavors-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime fills its lines with tall lowercase and a steady drafting-pen stroke. Set under the whimsical, pencil-stubby Flavors, its typewriter precision becomes the strongest thing the pair has going.
gen-flavors-gf-days-one: Approachable from the first line, Days One fills its line with tall lowercase spaced like rope-ladder rungs. Against Flavors, whose stems and arches share one thickness, the strongest quality is how sturdy they both feel.
